title: Native executor fixture: read the result
scenario: Maintainer workflow for a credential-free mock. Requires an authorized isolated executor, a pinned native client and a new private evidence directory. Screenshots are browser-rendered summaries of actual results, not terminal captures or real inference.

steps.title: Run once and inspect the receipt
steps.instruction: Prepare the exact private command/executor plan from the fixture guide. Run native_execution.py with a new --output directory. Read status, reason, terminal and cleanup in receipt.json; retain every blocked attempt. The examples below are fresh public CLI checks using a local fake app-server.
steps.caption: Browser-rendered actual CLI stdout: local fake-process success exits 0; terminal failure exits 1. Displayed paths are generalized.
steps.expected: A blocked terminal stays blocked. mock_complete describes the mock protocol; live_eligible, authentication_qualified and isolation_qualified remain false.

steps.title: Check actual native evidence and its limits
steps.instruction: Before reusing a native result, match all runtime hashes and review actual tool outputs, terminal identity and separate executor cleanup evidence. This source-bound native mock was run once; authentication and additional routes require their own qualification.
steps.caption: Browser-rendered sanitized summary of the actual 2026-10-18 native mock. It is not a terminal screenshot or a live model result.
steps.expected: Two synthetic submissions, one cell and a completed native terminal. Exact owned resources were absent afterward. No retry, auth, real inference or full-route claim.
